column7: \class BooleanAlgebra \extends BoundedDistributiveLattice, HeytingAlebra { | compl : E -> E | compl-meet {a : E} : a ∧ compl a <= bottom | compl-join {a : E} : top <= a ∨ compl a | --> => \lam a b => compl a ∨ b | <=-curry => \lam xa<=b => meet-univ <=-refl top-univ <=∘ meet-monotone <=-refl compl-join <=∘ ldistr>= <=∘ join-comm =<= join-monotone meet-right xa<=b | <=-uncurry => \lam x<=a-->b => meet-monotone x<=a-->b <=-refl <=∘ rdistr>= <=∘ join-univ (meet-comm =<= compl-meet <=∘ bottom-univ) meet-left }
\lemma compl-adj {a b : E} (ab : a ∧ b <= bottom) : a <= compl b
\lemma compl-mono {a b : E} (a<=b : a <= b) : compl b <= compl a
\lemma compl_meet {a b : E} : compl (a ∧ b) = compl a ∨ compl b
\lemma compl_join {a b : E} : compl (a ∨ b) = compl a ∧ compl b
\lemma compl_symm-diff {a b : E} : compl (symm-diff a b) = a ∧ b ∨ compl a ∧ compl b
